content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text addresses whether verses pressed against D2 vs C3 count as unanswered witnesses toward a broken link, which is the subject of K-G4.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"so the \"witness left unanswered\" ground fails and the collision is regraded UNDERDETERMINED; with that retraction the challenger's standing is corrected to SELF-SUPPORTED (L=6, c=0, no link BROKEN)","rule_words":"A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count.
